user.title: ⚙️ Blue Connect Configuration
user.description:
If the Blue Connect is not detected automatically, add its Bluetooth MAC address.

**The Access Code is not mandatory.** If you want to enable on-demand analyses, enter the 9 alphanumeric characters (e.g., B93XXXXXX). It is located under the USB port cap of the device, or on the probes' protection cap!

⚠️ Without a code, the device will operate in Passive Mode only: 1 Analysis per hour.

data.manual_mac_address: ✍️ Or enter the MAC address directly (e.g., AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
data.access_code: 🔑 Access Code (Leave empty for Passive Mode: 1 Analysis per hour)

data_description.chlorine_model: Sanitizer used in your pool. Bromine disables the CyA entity, which is not relevant for it. Kept for future use: no calculated value depends on it yet.
data_description.cya: Cyanuric acid (stabilizer) level in mg/l; use 0 if you don't use a stabilizer. Kept for future use: no calculated value depends on it yet.

data_description.reference_time: Anchor time used to align scheduled analyses on regular slots (e.g. 08:00, 10:00, 12:00... for a 2-hour interval).
data_description.scan_interval: Time between two scheduled analyses, from 5 to 1440 minutes. Active Mode only (requires the access code).
data_description.passive_measures: Use the readings the probe broadcasts on its own, about one per hour. Works without an access code.
data_description.ignore_echoes: Ignore the passive frames the probe flags as echoes of an analysis, so they don't overwrite the latest measurement.

data_description.ph_calib_7: The raw pH value your probe actually measured while dipped in this calibration solution (not the solution's nominal value).
data_description.ph_calib_4: The raw pH value your probe actually measured while dipped in this calibration solution (not the solution's nominal value).
data_description.ph_ref_7: The pH of this calibration solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the table on the bottle.
data_description.ph_ref_4: The pH of this calibration solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the table on the bottle.
data_description.orp_calib: The raw ORP value (mV) your probe actually displayed while dipped in the reference solution.
data_description.orp_ref: The ORP value (mV) of the reference solution at its current temperature: it varies with temperature, see the bottle. The correction applied is this value minus the measured one.
data_description.temp_offset: Correction in °C added to the temperature measured by the probe. Can be positive or negative.

data_description.access_code: Found on a sticker under the USB port cap, or on the probes' protection cap. Required for on-demand analyses; leave empty for passive-only listening.
data_description.mac_address: Pick a Blue Connect detected nearby by Home Assistant's Bluetooth. If yours is not listed, use the field below.
data_description.manual_mac_address: Only needed if your device is not listed above. Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, as shown in Home Assistant's Bluetooth settings.
